• Good working knowledge of Jira.
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including working effectively with distributed and vendor teams.

Desirable

• Experience testing applications backed by a BFF or microservices architecture.
• Experience with feature flags, progressive rollouts, and testing in production-like conditions.

• Experience with observability tooling and using logs, traces, and crash analytics to investigate defects.
• Experience with headless CMS or content-driven applications.

Nu's Business Control Officers (BCOs) are the first-line risk representatives embedded in each business unit. They make sure we understand the regulations we must follow, that controls are in place, and that our systems operate as intended across operational and regulatory risk.

This role will redefine what a BCO is at Nu. You will move the function from coordination to leadership: setting the standards, methodologies and training that make first-line risk management consistent, high-quality and credible with regulators, across every market.

You will also own how Nu delivers cross-team regulatory change. As the company grows, many regulations touch several teams at once. You will establish clear ownership, escalation paths and a small delivery office that makes sure these commitments land on time.

- Define the standards and methodologies for first-line risk management, and the role expectations for BCOs across business units
